subject: The Ariadne in orbit over a dun and red worn-flat world, and ahead of her, a little higher, a second, older colony ship, dark from end to end, one running light on its hull.
notes: Barrens Part 1, the Crossing. Screenprint light. No faces needed: the card names the officers, and whoever holds the seat varies. Barrens must look the same in every picture of it from orbit (Lachlan, 2026-11-26: the card and the in-orbit banner showed two different planets): match the arrival film arrival_barren, and use the same planet for brn_board and any later orbit shot.
